name: srs_schedule
description: Spaced-repetition scheduling with SuperMemo 2: from a review graded 0 to 5 and the card's state (repetitions, easiness factor, last interval), the next interval in days, the new easiness and the next review date. Or replay a card's whole review history. Exact easiness arithmetic.

quality.description: 5 perfect, 4 after hesitation, 3 with difficulty, 0-2 forgotten

reviews.description: A whole history instead of one review

catalog.source: Woźniak, SuperMemo 2 algorithm (1987, published at super-memory.com); FSRS (py-fsrs) is not included
